decision: Where does our pricing page lose buyers, and can a live price test answer our question in the time we have?
limitations: Every page needs all 21 checks answered (use "unsure" if you have not looked; it scores zero). Missing or unknown check ids stop the run, so a half-answered page cannot score 100%.
The 21 checks and weights are AAJ's judgement applied to your yes, partly or no answers. They are not a benchmark and cannot see real buyer behaviour.
The honesty checks point at US rules (ROSCA, California auto-renewal, FTC pricing guides). They do not replace legal review and do not cover rules outside the US.
The test plan rests on your guess at conversion at the new price. Before-after and sales-quote reads are not randomised and give direction only.
review: Whoever owns the pricing page answers every check from the live page; finance confirms both prices are on the same basis and conversion comes from a month of analytics; legal checks the honesty and terms items.
